args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after latest deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release known healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging, so it wasn't eligible).
2. **Rolled back:** Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions.
3. **Verified:** checkout-api is now healthy in all regions with a normal error rate of 0.002.
4. **Opened incident:** Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after latest deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure, the rollback, and the verification results. The on-call engineer has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production. Root cause analysis of v2.3.1 is still outstanding and noted in the incident.
